title: Telegram polling handed over on activation
goal: After relocation only the new main polls and answers Telegram; the old main stops
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: A fenced, draining or standby base never runs poll() or sends Bot API calls; the new main hydrates Telegram state and starts polling on activation (tests)
A relocation test shows the old main stops answering and the new main answers, with no 409 polling race
validation: Directed regressions in the named test files
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
